issues.description: Fixed an issue where high CPU utilization caused GlobalProtect VPN tunnels to flap, users to be disconnected, and the CLI to become unresponsive. This occurred when a large number of GlobalProtect users were actively processing application traffic.
(PA-5450 firewalls only) Fixed an issue where the all_pktproc process stopped responding when the firewall was on PAN-OS 10.1.9-h3 or a later release.
